FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

Utah fishing licence

Anglers aged 12 or older need a fishing licence. The reduced senior price applies to residents, not visiting seniors.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Residents and non-residents aged 12 or older.

Who doesn’t

  • Children aged 11 or younger.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Non-resident 3-daynon resident3 days$44 USD
Non-resident 7-daynon resident7 days$91 USD
Non-resident adult annualnon resident365 days$120 USD
Non-resident youth annual, ages 12–13non resident365 days$18 USD
Non-resident youth annual, ages 14–17non resident365 days$44 USD

Extra stamps and permits

  • Non-resident setline permit · $48 USD
    Required to use a setline, with a valid fishing licence.

Rules visitors should know

  • The setline permit is valid only with the fishing licence.
  • Online and in-person card payments have a 2.2 percent transaction fee.

How to buy

Use DWR's online licence service or an in-person licence seller.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Utah?

Anglers aged 12 or older need a fishing licence. The reduced senior price applies to residents, not visiting seniors.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Utah?

Non-resident 3-day: $44 USD; Non-resident 7-day: $91 USD; Non-resident adult annual: $120 USD; Non-resident youth annual, ages 12–13: $18 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Utah?

Use DWR's online licence service or an in-person licence seller.
